text:
dara: quick readout from the saffron15b bench (summ + long extractive QA). need a short routing + canary recommendation for GTN/product.

rene: paste the topline numbers pls

dara: condensed table (aggregated across our 5 priority slices):
```
model     | quant | EM / RougeL | p95_ms | cost/q($)
saffron15b| fp16  | 78.5 / 61.3 | 580    | 0.022
saffron15b| int8  | 78.1 / 60.8 | 410    | 0.0075
saffron15b| int4  | 76.0 / 58.9 | 300    | 0.0036
mini9b    | int4  | 72.8 / 54.2 | 260    | 0.0019
```
Notes: fp16->int8 drop small (~0.4 EM), int4 shows ~2.5 EM drop concentrated on multi-hop and few-shot summarization. warming KV cache (70-85% hit) reduces effective cost by ~30-50% and cuts p95 by ~20-30ms.

priya: product wants simple rule: quality >= baseline-X and cost <= Y. propose routing?

sam: proposed routing: short/simple (<120 tokens) -> mini9b-int4; medium (120-450) -> saffron15b-int8; long/multi-hop (>450) -> saffron15b-int8 with fp16 fallback when confidence/reranker below threshold.

rene: canary cadence: 0.5% for 6h -> 3% for 18h -> 15% for 48h. rollback if any critical slice EM drop >1.5 or hallucination +2pp or p95 > +25%.

priya: autopromote rules: allow autopromote for self-serve when post-kv effective cost <=0.6x fp16 AND avg per-slice EM drop <=1.0 for critical slices <=0.7. otherwise SE review.

sam: infra note: expose flags in routing: `max_em_drop_slice`, `effective_cost_ratio`, `min_kv_hit`, `canary_steps`, `fallback_trigger`. GTN UI should display the one-line reasoning.

dara: one-liner for GTN: "mini9b-int4 for short queries saves ~80% cost with modest quality loss; saffron15b-int8 is the balance for longer or higher-recall queries, with fp16 fallback for safety."

infra-bot: scheduled 24h synthetic drive with representative KV hit distribution; will post results to the handoff doc and tag @priya when complete.

priya: great, please add the proposed flags to the routing defaults and Ill draft the GTN handoff blurb.

dara: will add to the handoff doc and tag everyone once synthetic run posts results. :thumbsup:
